notes.title: Damage UI fixed and Trophies
notes.notes: We finally fixed the damage UI. We also delayed the update to be able to add trophies to the game! We are working now in pretty icons for them, they will be there soon!

notes.title: Red flickering temporal fix
notes.notes:
Some players have encounter a permanent red flickering when starting the game. While we try to find a definitive fix for the red flickering we have release a patch that disable the origin. To allow everyone to play.

This bug happens because of the latest NVIDIA drivers that has conflicts with post processing we use for player damage. We will be back to it as soon as possible. As we have such a small team, we are not always available when bugs appear.

Thanks for keep playing <3

notes.title: Release Patch
notes.notes:
The game just released and we wanted to make sure everything was bugless and updated! 

We hope you enjoy your game! Don't doubt to contact us for feedback for questions in our discord.
